correctness.rationale: With \(B=I-A/L\), Stieltjes signs and the spectral endpoint imply \(B\ge0\) entrywise and \(B\succeq0\). The exact polynomial recurrence gives nonnegative coefficients through degree three, and the only potentially negative coefficient for the fifth iterate is \((1+\beta)^2(1-2\beta)\). This is nonnegative exactly for \(\kappa\le9\). For every \(\kappa>9\), the explicit weak-coupling construction has exact spectral endpoints and makes the distance-three entry of the fifth-iterate polynomial negative. The packaged rational witness independently replays all arithmetic.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Objective-spike and stagewise Euclidean-nonexpansion theorems control different observables. Neither implies entrywise positivity of Nesterov iterates on the Stieltjes cone or the quantified fifth-iterate threshold.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a natural and sharp boundary between spectral acceleration and coordinatewise order preservation on a canonical inverse-positive class. It is stronger than a single counterexample: four iterations are proved universally safe, the fifth has an exact condition-number iff threshold, and every larger condition number is covered by one explicit family. This is directly relevant when nonnegative coordinates represent physically meaningful states or feasibility.
